	NOR = {

		government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer
		government_has_flag = government_is_merchant
		government_has_flag = government_is_republic

	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			government_has_mechanic = administrative
		}

			is_independent_ruler = yes
			tgp_is_ceremonial_liege_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

# 2.14 batch D3 (Codex #1): may they have the clicked trait? add_trait refuses outside a trait's age range or sex, so
# the All traits add asks this BEFORE it removes anything. Generated from TRAIT_LIMITS (vanilla 1.21). Limit: a trait of
# another mod is not in the table and counts as eligible, so its clear-then-add can still end in a refusal.
one_trait_any_trait_eligible_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_diplomacy_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_diplomacy_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_diplomacy_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_diplomacy_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_diplomacy_5
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_5
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_stewardship_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_stewardship_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_stewardship_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_stewardship_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_stewardship_5
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_intrigue_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_intrigue_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_intrigue_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_intrigue_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_intrigue_5
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_learning_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_learning_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_learning_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_learning_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_learning_5
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_prowess_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_prowess_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_prowess_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_martial_prowess_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_republican_knowledge_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_republican_knowledge_2
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_republican_knowledge_3
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_republican_knowledge_4
				scope:picked_trait = trait:education_republican_knowledge_5
				scope:picked_trait = trait:lifestyle_merchant
			}
		}
		age >= 16
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:picked_trait = trait:eunuch_1
				scope:picked_trait = trait:beardless_eunuch
			}
		}
		is_male = yes
	}
	trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

# 2.14 batch D3: a left click would take something from them (the "Replaces:" line's test).
one_trait_any_trait_would_replace_trigger = {
	NOT = { has_trait = scope:picked_trait }
	one_trait_any_trait_eligible_trigger = yes
	save_temporary_scope_as = one_trait_trait_holder
	OR = {
		scope:picked_trait = { any_opposite_trait = { scope:one_trait_trait_holder = { has_trait = prev } } }
		one_trait_any_trait_group_held_trigger = yes
	}
}
